description: Pre-existing debugger-context mismatch reproduced before and after the UART bootstrap refactor; expected simulator behavior was preserved.

measurements.configuration: PLL 200 MHz / UART 115200 with 100 ms startup wait
measurements.source:
//? WINDTUNNEL CHECK LIST
//? profile: program
//? stop: _end
//? timeout-ms: 1000
//? baudrate: 115200
//? max-cycles: 3_000_000
//? stdout: "\xf8\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\xf8\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x2a\x84\x01\x00\x00\x02\x00\x00\x00\x87\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00"

// Input overlays, custom IJMP0, RESI0 and generalized CALLD returns.
const CLOCK = Hub.clockMode(pll=#on, in_div=1, mul=10, out_div=1, xi=#15pF, sysclk=#pll)
const UART  = SmartPin.UartTx.config(baud=115_200, bits=8, clk=200_000_000)
.cogexec    0
                HUBSET  aug(CLOCK)
                WRPIN   P_TT_01 | P_ASYNC_TX,   62
                WXPIN   aug(UART),              62
                DIRH    62
                WAITX   aug(20_000_000)
                // Copy the actual sixteen-long ISR image into cog 1's cached debugger slot.
                SETQ    15
                RDLONG  register(0x100),        aug(hubaddr(debug_image))
                SETQ    15
                WRLONG  register(0x100),        aug(0xFFF40)
                HUBSET  aug(0x20000002)
                COGINIT 1,                      aug(hubaddr(target))
                WAITX   aug(10000)
                MOV     PTRB,                   aug(0x1000)
                MOV     register(0x90),         40
byte:
                RDBYTE  PA, PTRB++
                WYPIN   PA, 62
                WAITX   1
ready:
                TESTP   62                      :wc
    if(!C)      JMP     ready
                DJNZ    register(0x90), byte
                WAITX   aug(20000)
_end:
                JMP     _end
.pack   off
.cogexec    0x2000, 0
debug_image:
                JMP     nrel(first_handler)
                LONG    [0] * 15
.cogexec    0x3000, 0
target:
                BRK     42
                BRK     43
                // Application status must have lost all debug-only fields on return.
                GETBRK  register(0x89)              :wcz
                SETQ    9
                WRLONG  register(0x80), aug(0x1000)
                COGSTOP 1
.org    0x100
first_handler:
        // Selecting pin inputs must leave the writable debug register bank intact.
                MOV     register(0x80), INA
                MOV     register(0x81), INB
                BRK     aug(0x800)
                MOV     INA,            3
                MOV     INB,            4
                BRK     0
                MOV     register(0x82), INA
                MOV     register(0x83), INB
                MOV     INA,            aug(cogaddr(custom_handler))
                BRK     16
                JMP     nrel(0x1fd)
.org    0x180
custom_handler:
                MOV     register(0x84), INB
                GETBRK  register(0x85)      :wcz
                // RESI0 saves the next debug address in IJMP0, while resuming application PC.
                BRK     16
                RESI0
                MOV     register(0x86), INA
                MOV     register(0x87), INB
                // Successful register-source CALLD through INB ends debug service for any D.
                CALLD   register(0x88), INB :wcz

                MOV     register(0x82), INA
                MOV     register(0x83), INB
                MOV     INA,            aug(cogaddr(custom_handler))

                JMP     nrel(0x1fd)
.org    0x180
custom_handler:
                MOV     register(0x84), INB
                GETBRK  register(0x85)      :wcz
                // RESI0 saves the next debug address in IJMP0, while resuming application PC.
                BRK     16
                RESI0

                // Successful register-source CALLD through INB ends debug service for any D.
